criteria.name: voice_distinctness
criteria.description: Each character sounds like themselves — vocabulary, sentence length, habits match their speech_patterns. Lines are not interchangeable between characters.

criteria.name: dramatic_payoff
criteria.description: The dramatic_question is felt by the end. what_changes has happened. Any revelation lands obliquely — no character says the theme plainly.

criteria.name: subtext
criteria.description: Characters don't explain the plot to each other. Meaning lives beneath the surface — in what's avoided, deflected, or said sideways.

criteria.name: setting_constraint
criteria.description: If the setting_constraint restricts speech (observed, interrupted, formal), those restrictions are honored in what characters say and how.
